47-file handbook · encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Enter the passphrase to unlock.

How this protects you: the file you are looking at contains only ciphertext. Without the passphrase nobody can read the handbook, and search engines are told not to index it. How it does not protect you: anyone who can reach the URL can still download the encrypted blob, and anyone who has the passphrase can read, copy and re-share everything inside it.
